note: 1390 -> 1389. Net of the base.py composition-root extraction (_HooksMixin / _DisplayNameMixin / _FieldComputeMixin). Moving _compute_display_name and name_create off BaseModel onto a leaf exposed that display_name resolves on BaseModel -- it is a real Char descriptor contributed by _MagicFieldsMixin -- but on no individual mixin, so it is now declared on _ModelStubs, along with create(). Declared as Char really types it, 'str | Literal[False]'. Note the honest-vs-lower tension, because it is the same one that produced the has_unaccent defect this audit started from: spelling it 'display_name: str' measures 1387, two LOWER, because two callers assume str -- and it would be a false declaration, since a Char genuinely yields False when unset. The remaining cost on _DisplayNameMixin is two [misc] '__slots__' assignment reports (the same shape as the pre-existing one on recompute.py's _ids) and one [return-value] on name_create, whose annotation says tuple[int, str] while display_name may be False. Those three are the price of a truthful declaration and are left visible rather than annotated away. MEASURE COLD: rm -rf .mypy_cache first; a warm cache reads two lower.
